# The Diversity Movement

> The Diversity Movement (TDM) provides comprehensive diversity and inclusion training solutions, analytics, and consulting to help organizations build inclusive cultures and develop diverse leadership.

The Diversity Movement specializes in DEI consulting and organizational transformation through evidence-based training programs, leadership development, and culture assessments. Their platform combines interactive learning tools with analytics to drive measurable business impact.

## Key Topics

- Diversity & Inclusion (DEI)
- Leadership Development
- Organizational Transformation
- Inclusive Culture
- Employee Engagement
- LeaderView
- MicroVideos
- Culture Assessment
- Certified Diversity Executives
- Analytics
- Business Impact
- Coaching
- Diversity Initiatives
- Online Courses
- Content Library

## Core Platform & Solutions

- [The Diversity Movement](https://thediversitymovement.com): Homepage for TDM's diversity and inclusion training solutions including LeaderView and MicroVideos.
